item.title: [75] Amazon EMR now supports native data quality checks in Apache Spark jobs
item.description: Amazon EMR now validates data quality natively within Apache Spark jobs. Data engineering teams can catch quality issues inline before bad data reaches downstream systems, without building or maintaining separate validation infrastructure.
